question: Choose the word that is the antonym of Glanced.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stared**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"glanced"** means to take a quick or brief look at something. (झलक देखना)
 
 
• **Example:** She glanced at her watch to check the time.
 
 
• **"Stared"** refers to looking fixedly or intently at something for a longer duration, often with concentration or amazement. (टकटकी लगाना)
 
 
• **Example:** He stared at the painting for hours, admiring its intricate details.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'glanced'** is **'stared'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stared**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Peeked** (झाँकना): To look quickly or secretly, often through a small opening.
 
 
• **Example:** The child peeked through the curtains to see what was happening outside.
 
 

 
• **Skimmed** (सतही तौर पर पढ़ना): To read or look over something quickly, without focusing on the details.
 
 
• **Example:** She skimmed through the book to find the key points for her presentation.
 
 

 
• **Peeped** (चुपके से देखना): To take a brief or furtive look, often without being noticed.
 
 
• **Example:** He peeped into the room to see if anyone was there.
